title: Publish your Lovable project
goal: Publish the project so it has a public link

steps.find: your project in the Lovable editor

steps.say: Press Publish in the top right of the editor, next to Share. Nothing goes live until you press Publish again in the window that opens.
steps.find: the Publish button next to Share, top right

steps.say: Check the Website URL it suggests (it ends in lovable.app) and Who can view your site: Public means anyone with the link can see it.
steps.find: the Website URL box and Who can view your site

steps.say: Look at the security check line, then press Publish in the window.
steps.find: the Publish button in the window

instead.say: If it says build errors need fixing, use Try to fix first and publish after.
instead.find: Try to fix in the Publish window

steps.say: When it says Your website is live, use the copy link or visit site button, and check the page loads.
steps.find: the copy link or visit site button

instead.say: If the project is already live, the button says Publish changes instead.
